tools.name: otterwaiver_list_waivers
tools.description: List the waivers of the account (title, event, status draft/active/inactive, activities, response counts). Page numbers are required by the API; the defaults are page 1 with 20 records. Filter by event name (waiver folder title) or waiver title. API: GET /waivers.

tools.name: otterwaiver_get_waiver
tools.description: Get one waiver with its full text, settings, additional fields and signed participants. Get the id from otterwaiver_list_waivers. API: GET /waivers/{id}.

tools.name: otterwaiver_list_latest_participants
tools.description: List the 50 most recent participants who signed a waiver: signer contact data, emergency contact, answers to extra questions, timestamps and document links. The data is personal data of the signers. API: GET /participants/latest.

tools.name: otterwaiver_list_latest_checkins
tools.description: List the 50 most recent participant check-ins, with the same fields as otterwaiver_list_latest_participants (the checkedIn timestamp is set). API: GET /participants/latest/checkins.

tools.name: otterwaiver_get_participant
tools.description: Get one participant (adult or minor) by id: signer data, waiver id, timestamps, document and certificate links. Get the id from the participant lists or from a waiver. API: GET /participants/{id}.
